userInputText: Gobble is an arcade game where you play as a mouth on the ground and your goal is to eat everything but people! Move around the ground and devour everything in sight, from cacti and rocks to trees and boxes! Each puzzle is related to the previous one, but there are always new tricks and problems to solve! Each new part brings a more interesting challenge, so see how far you can go, and don't forget, don't eat people!
